title: Ijwi ry'Ubwenge mu Gicucu
intro: Umuntu wo mu bihe bya kera, uzwiho ubushishozi bwimbitse, akubwira mu binyejana byinshi. Uyu muntu ntiyigeze avuga ko ari umuhanuzi, ariko ubwenge bw'Imana bwanyuze mu magambo ye. Umubyeyi wasize umurage w'ubuyobozi buhoraho, inama ze ziracyari mu mitima y'abantu babarirwa muri za miriyoni, zivugwa kandi zitekerezwaho kugeza n'uyu munsi.
clues: Nahawe impano y'Imana yanshyize ku ruhande - ubwenge bwimbitse cyane ku buryo bwabaye ikimenyetso cy'ingenzi mu mateka yanjye.
Ntabwo nari intumwa cyangwa umumarayika - nari umuntu ufite ubumenyi bwimbitse n'ubushishozi ku isi.
Ubucuti bwanjye bwa hafi bwari ubwo umwana wanjye, kandi binyuze muri ubwo bucuti, ubutumwa bwanjye burambye bwatanzwe.
Nasabye gushimira Uwampaye byose, kandi mbwiriza kwirinda ubwibone n'ubwibone.
Nigishije ku buremere bw'ibikorwa by'akabuto ka sinapi, n'akamaro ko kugabanya ijwi ryawe mu kwicisha bugufi.
Igice kimwe muri Korowani cyitwa izina ryanjye, aho inama nagiriye umwana wanjye nkunda zigumaho iteka ryose.

arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا لُقْمَـٰنَ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ أَنِ ٱشْكُرْ لِلَّهِ ۚ وَمَن يَشْكُرْ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِىٌّ حَمِيدٌۭ
verse: And We had certainly given Luqmān wisdom [and said], "Be grateful to Allāh." And whoever is grateful is grateful for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever denies [His favor] - then indeed, Allāh is Free of need and Praiseworthy. (31:12)
